units: B. Bath. 12ᵃ מ׳ בכרם וכ׳ I sell thee a portion of my vineyard.—מְנַת המלך the king’s share (annona).
<cite ref="Nedarim 62b:2">Ned. 62ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Bava Batra 8a:5">B. Bath. 8ᵃ</cite>, v. <cite ref="M01712"><he>מִנְדָּה</he></cite>.
Ab. Zar. 71ᵃ הפס עלי מ׳ מלך settle for me the annona (in kind or money).

senses.gloss: appointment; בִּמְנַת, עַל מְנַת (abbrev. ע״מ) on condition that, for the sake of.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Demai 6:13">Tosef. Dem. VI, 13</cite> <he>ואם התנה עמו במ׳ כן</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. … <he>מתחלה ע״מ לעשות כן</he>) but if he originally had made that agreement (of dividing the profits) with him.
<cite ref="Tosefta Demai 7:3">Ib. VII, 3</cite> <he>ע״מ שהמעשרות שלי</he> with the condition that the tithes be mine.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Bava Metzia 5:4:2">Y. B. Mets. V, 10ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>במ׳ לעלות לו וכ׳</he> with the condition that he will give him (as his share) one new-born animal or one crop of wool.

<cite ref="Tosefta Sanhedrin 11:2">Tosef. Snh. XI, 2</cite> <he>יודע אני וע״מ כן אני עושה</he> I know (the nature of the offence and its penalty), and on that condition I am committing it; Mekh. Mishp. s. 20 <he>יודע אני ע״מ כן</he> (read: <he>וע״מ</he>).
<cite ref="Kiddushin 6b:12">Kidd. 6ᵇ</cite> <he>מתנה ע״מ להחזיר</he> a present made with the condition that it shall be returned (possession for the time being); a. v. fr.—

<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 37a:11">Ab. Zar. 37ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>כל האומר ע״מ … מעכשיו דמי</he> if a man says ‘on condition’, it is to be considered as if he had said ‘from now’, i.e. the stipulated transaction takes retrospective effect when the condition is fulfilled.—

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Batra 10:8">B. Bath. X, 8</cite> (<cite ref="Bava Batra 175b:4">175ᵇ</cite>) <he>על מְנָתוֹ הלוהו</he> Ar. (ed. <he>אמונתו</he>, v. <cite ref="A02001"><he>אֱמוּנָה</he></cite>) he extended the loan to him (the friend) on the condition which he (the guarantor) offered.
